parts:
I'm not seeing any problems now, have you fixed it in the meantime?

On Tue, Dec 9, 2014 at 3:42 AM, gjabel <g.j....@gmail.com> wrote:
I was trying to add some new features to a shiny app this morning, so I installed the latest version of shiny on our server, via sudo R -e "devtools::install_github('rstudio/shiny')"

I found it would not display the sliders in the side bar properly or the URL links in the datatables...
http://witt.null2.net/shiny/wic/

Is this standard with developing versions of shiny from github or am I doing something wrong? I can get the sliders to appear when I install shiny from devtools on my local PC, but the URL links still don't display.

Given the problems, I want to switch back to the original CRAN version of shiny I was using, however, when I do so I get some really strange layout behaviour (the sidebar covers the full width with the main panel below and the selectInput fields are one character wide). I am now stuck in a situation where I cannot get a working version running.
